description: Livestream from New Systems (NYC) — Pi is the extensible coding agent behind OpenClaw. Featuring a talk from Daniel Griesser on his journey with Pi, a live AMA with Pi creator Mario Zechner and Armin Ronacher, plus a Pi extensions tour with Ben Vinegar. March 14, 12pm–4pm EST.
